mandatory_gates.criterion: A fresh shell can run one RFT and one DasAtom smoke case using documented commands.
The agent explains Algorithm 1 and shows a traceable source-to-code map.
The manuscript/snapshot/corrected control distinction is explicit; no uncertain variant is called exact paper reproduction.
Every scientific clarification C1–C8 has an owner and a recorded resolution plan.
Input normalization and output accounting are specified sufficiently for Phase 01.
Deterministic repeatability is tested twice, or all stochastic sources are identified for controlled repetition.

scope: Evidence consistency and explicit gate accounting; no compiler/environment validation
